Held at their 2025 class (21), with 2050 population

The 21 frozen economies carry 204 million people in 2050, 2.2 percent of the classified total. Fifteen are high-income territories of negligible size; the six that matter are Yemen, Korea Dem. Rep., Syria, South Sudan, Cuba and Eritrea.
